name: Ana Catarina Mendes - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2024 Rule of Law Report
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on the rule of law in the European Union. It calls on the European Commission to do more to protect independent courts, fight corruption, defend media freedom and support civil society groups. It asks for stronger action when countries ignore court rulings or misuse European Union money. It also wants the yearly rule of law report to cover more ground, including the European Union's own institutions and countries hoping to join.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament states its position and asks the Commission to act.
- **Who it affects:** Courts, journalists, civil society groups and people in European Union countries and candidate countries.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is asked to report by 31 December 2025 on which requests it will carry out.
